numericPolicy.rule: Number plus scientific unit requires Claim ID and real source. P0 has neither. Gameplay clocks must not be relabeled as sensor specs.

worldRules.rule: Sealed Bio-Rig / sealed probe stays closed. External service ports only. No sequences, culture conditions, concentrations, or wet-lab how-to.
Failed positive / sun reference keeps unknown / question-mark unread and unusable as evidence until moon-low and sun-high are restored.
First invalid run is written to evidence.runHistory and cannot be deleted. Station wall keeps the event.
Public map opens only obtained valid layers. 全河安全 and 已完成清理 show 目前沒有資料圖層.
Player does not sample, open the unknown, publish official identity, enforce, or approve deployment. Confirmation rover enters; lab publishes formal result later.
Reporter output must include shape, sound, or fill animation. Chen walk pass requires shape+sound AND municipal update with timestamp.
Readouts use relative states only: low / mid / high / fluctuating, triangle fill, pulse density. No real units, LOD, concentration, or calibration curve.
After repair, UI never shows 100% 準確. Show only two control states and this-run session clock.
Both monitoring models complete the chapter and change harbor plus Hub far-view. Not a moral score.
Workshop is skippable with no qualification warning and does not lock Chapter 1. Only forks 林博士 living vs formal phrasing.
Mainline must not present MerR, Pmer, dTomato, Hg²⁺, or aptamer as a gate or as the probe's identity.
No environmental release of a living system. No zero-risk or fully-safe claims.
